en: [color=#d60600]Red[/color], [color=#3959c2]blue[/color], [color=#77239c]purple[/color] and [color=#007a10]green[/color] gems represent different elements. They can be arranged in a circle.

The [color=#c9a532]yellow[/color] one is neutral. Combining a [color=#c9a532]yellow[/color] with an elemental gem transposes it to the opposite element, e.g. [color=#3959c2]blue[/color] + [color=#c9a532]yellow[/color] → [color=#d60600]red[/color] + [color=#c9a532]yellow[/color].

Combining two different elemental gems usually gives you two other elemental gems e.g. [color=#3959c2]blue[/color] + [color=#007a10]green[/color] -> [color=#d60600]red[/color] + [color=#77239c]purple[/color].

However, when you combine two [color=#3959c2]oppo[/color][color=#d60600]site[/color] elemental gems, they can neutralize each other, producing two [color=#c9a532]yellow[/color] gems! And two [color=#c9a532]yellow[/color] gems, in turn, can produce two other [color=#007a10]oppo[/color][color=#77239c]site[/color] gems.

The [color=#7c7c7c]black[/color] and [color=#c0c0c0]white[/color] gems change the elemental gems either clockwise or counter-clockwise. And [color=#c9a532]yellow[/color] gem transposes those two between each other as well.

This lectern is controlled by the gems, inserted in the holder right next to it. It holds the ancient knowledge which can assist you in traversing The Labyrinth!

The round carpets teleport you. Most carpets in The Labyrinth teleport to this room. There are 20 valid destination spots, but only 17 rooms a teleport can lead to.
The carpet in this room can be controlled by the gem holders below it. For a proper setup, both must be occupied by gems.
The order in which the gems are inserted into the teleport controls doesn’t matter. The same gem combination always leads to the same spot.
A [color=#c9a532]citrine[/color] with an [color=#77239c]amethyst[/color] lead to fourth spot. Same as a [color=#3959c2]sapphire[/color] with a [color=#d60600]ruby[/color].
The active teleport destination is a sum of two gems inserted in the teleport controls.

The teleport destination spots are arranged in a three by seven grid and are counted from the top-left starting from zero. A cultist is near the second, a knife is near the eighth and the summoning circle by the eleventh.

Each gem has a number associated with it:
[color=#007a10]emerald[/color] is 6
[color=#c9a532]citrine[/color] is 0
 [color=#d60600]ruby[/color] is 3
[color=#7c7c7c]onyx[/color] is 9
[color=#3959c2]sapphire[/color] is 1
 [color=#77239c]amethyst[/color] is 4
[color=#c0c0c0]diamond[/color] is 10
